def copy_in_place
  (sdk : aspis_s126_owned_sdk.OwnedSdk) (slot : Std.Usize)
  (source : Slice Std.U8) :
  Result ((core.result.Result Unit solana_program_error.ProgramError) ×
    aspis_s126_owned_sdk.OwnedSdk)
  := do

    alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice
      aspis_s126_owned_sdk.OwnedDataCell) sdk.data_cells slot
